title: Fixture expectation v1
description: fixtures/oracle-candidates/<name>/expect.json. `wrong` edges must be absent and `right` edges present for the fixture to count as FIXED; a fixture with no `wrong` edges is BROKEN while a `right` edge is missing. Validated by lib/expect.ts.

from.description: the caller's qualified name, as the subject writes it

fromFile.description: the caller's file, when its qualified name is not unique

toLine.description: the target's start line, to pick one of several same-named targets
